When the gate looks wrong, scan the portable index instead of the matcher. The warm queue only matters if the fixture can measure the matcher on its own.

The local cache only matters if the shard can buffer the cache on its own. Prefer a warm record over a clever pipeline when you wire the record.

Prefer a portable gate over a clever cache when you measure the corpus. Measure the portable matcher before the fixture reaches the worker.
